lines.text: David stays in Jerusalem while Joab besieges Rabbah, and David sends for Bathsheba, the wife of Uriah, and sleeps with her.
David summons Uriah from the battle and tells him to go home, but Uriah sleeps in a tent outside the city.

wrong_details.wrong: Uriah sleeps in a tent outside the city
wrong_details.true: Uriah sleeps at the door of the palace with all his master's servants

lines.text: Uriah refuses to go home while the ark and Israel dwell in tents, even after David gets him drunk.
David sends Joab a letter with Uriah, telling him to put Uriah at the front of the fiercest battle, and Uriah is taken captive.
Bathsheba mourns her husband, then David brings her to his house, she bears him a son, and the LORD sees it as evil.
